author: guitargeek
body:
Since commit 2b21745bf06 (PR #52172), HcalHardcodeCalibrations no longer produces HcalPFCorrs, but HcalDbProducer still consumes them for HcalDbService. A job with its HCAL conditions from HcalHardcodeCalibrations alone, without a global tag, fails as soon as it uses HcalDbService:

```txt
Cannot find EventSetup module to produce data of type "HcalPFCorrs" in
record "HcalPFCorrsRcd" with product label "".
```

HcalDbService::getHcalPFCorr() has no callers, so remove the PF corrections from HcalDbService, HcalDbProducer and the dependencies of HcalDbRecord rather than restore the hard-coded ones. The payload, its record, and the text and database tools for it stay.
title: HcalDbService: drop the PF corrections, which nothing reads
